title: Menu
subtitle: Enter items by hand. Free plan: 2 languages — your original plus one more ({locale}).
subtitlePro: Edit your {locale} menu, review the draft, then publish when ready.
publishConfirm: {count} items will go live. Customers will see the changes immediately.
emptyCategories: No categories yet. Add a category, then items.
proToolsHint: Faster menu setup with review before anything is published.
translationProHint: Pro translates missing menu content into another language, then lets you review every line before applying it.
translationHint: Choose a target language. Existing translations are kept, and the AI draft is never published automatically.
translationMonthlyLimitReached: You have used all AI translations for this month. The allowance resets next month.
translationApplied: Translations were added. Review the public menu and publish when ready.
translationLoadFailed: Could not load the latest translation draft.
translationFailed: Translation did not finish. Try again later or contact support.
translationApplyFailed: Could not apply this translation draft.
translationNothingMissing: Every menu entry already has this target language.
translationLocaleLimit: This store has reached its menu language limit.
translationSameLanguage: Choose a language different from the main menu language.
translationMenuTooLarge: This menu is too large for one translation job. Contact support to split it safely.
translationNameRequired: Every selected translation needs a name.
voiceExample: Say in Vietnamese: “Phở bò giá năm mươi nghìn”. You still confirm before saving.
voiceListeningHint: Listening in Vietnamese… Say the dish name, then “giá” and the price.
voiceDraftReady: Name and price filled. Check both before saving.
voicePriceMissing: Name filled, but the price was not clear. Enter the price before saving.
voiceUnsupported: Voice entry is not supported in this browser. Try Chrome or enter the item manually.
voicePermissionDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in browser settings or enter the item manually.
voiceFailed: Voice recognition did not finish. Try again or enter the item manually.
photoEnhanceProHint: AI photo enhancement is available on Pro.
photoEnhanceMonthlyLimitReached: You have used all photo enhancement previews for this month.
photoEnhanceProcessing: Creating a preview… You can leave this menu and return later.
photoEnhanceReviewHint: Compare carefully. The original stays unchanged until you choose the preview.
photoEnhanceInUse: The enhanced photo is in use. The original is still available.
photoEnhanceApplied: Enhanced photo applied. The original is still available to restore.
photoEnhanceLoadFailed: Could not load the latest photo preview.
photoEnhanceFailed: Photo enhancement did not finish. Try again later.
photoEnhanceSourceChanged: The original photo changed. Create a new preview from the current photo.
moreProToolsHint: Translation, Vietnamese voice entry, and reviewed photo enhancement are available on Pro.
importPrivacyHint: The selected file is sent to Xiaomi MiMo once for recognition. Review every item and price before applying it to your draft.
importMonthlyLimitReached: You have used all menu imports for this month. The allowance resets next month.
importChooseFile: Take a photo or choose a PDF
importFileHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 12 MB
importCanLeave: You can leave this page and come back later.
importFailed: Recognition did not finish. Your uploaded file is still available.
importServiceUnavailable: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later or contact support.
importRateLimited: The AI service is busy right now. Wait a minute, then try again.
importUnexpectedFailure: Try again. If it keeps failing, choose a clearer file or contact support.
importReviewHint: Uncheck anything you do not want. Low-confidence and missing prices need extra attention.
importLanguageWillChange: Detected {detected}, different from your current {base} menu. Because this menu is empty, applying the draft will set {detected} as its main language.
importLanguageMismatchExisting: This draft is in {detected}, but your existing menu uses {base}, so it can't be applied. Use "Discard & re-import" to upload it again — new imports are translated into {base} automatically.
importLowConfidence: Low confidence — check this against the original menu.
importApply: Add selected items to menu draft
importApplied: The reviewed items were added to your menu draft. Publish separately when ready.
importReviewRequired: Every selected row needs a name and confirmed price.
importLoadFailed: Could not load the latest AI draft.
importUploadFailed: Could not upload this menu file.
importApplyFailed: Could not apply the reviewed draft.
importTooLarge: The file must be 12 MB or smaller.
importUnsupported: Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.
importInvalidFile: This file is empty or does not match its file type.
invalidOption: Name or extra price is invalid.
emptyGroupsHint: No groups yet. Example: Size (required), Topping (optional).
imageErrorUnsupportedType: Only JPEG / PNG / WebP are supported
emptyTitle: Your menu is waiting for its first item
emptyHint: Start with a category, then add the dishes guests can order. Publish only after the menu looks right.
emptyStepCategory: Create a category such as Drinks or Main dishes.
emptyStepItem: Add a dish name and price inside that category.
emptyStepPublish: Publish the menu when at least one item is available.
itemDrawerBaseHint: Edit the item, category, photo, availability and options.
itemDrawerTranslationHint: Translate guest-facing text. Price, stock, category and photo stay shared.
chooseCategoryHint: Select an existing category or create one without leaving the item.
editCategoryHint: Update this category in the active menu language.
menuLanguagesHint: Choose the language you are editing. This does not change the app language.
freeLanguageLimitBody: The Free plan includes your main language ({base}) plus 1 more, with manual editing and AI translation in the monthly quota. Adding another language needs Pro, which supports up to 5 languages.
manualOrAiTranslation: Edit {language} by hand or use AI to fill missing text.
translationModeHint: Editing {language} translations. Menu structure, prices, stock and photos remain shared.
modifierTranslationsHint: Fill names for option groups and choices in this language.
importDrawerHint: Upload, review and apply a draft. Nothing is published automatically.
proToolsDismissFailed: Could not hide Pro tools. Try again.
newItemPhotoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {maxMb} MB. Uploaded right after the item is saved.
itemSavedImageFailed: The item was saved, but the photo couldn't be uploaded ({reason}). Open the item via Edit to try again.
quickAddLabel: One item per line: name - price
quickAddHint: Paste from a spreadsheet or your old menu. Commas, colons, tabs or spaces also work as separators. Up to {max} lines at a time; you can add photos and descriptions later.
quickAddErrorFormat: Couldn't find a name and price.
quickAddErrorTooMany: Too many lines – add the rest in the next batch.
quickAddFailed: Lines not added: {count}. They're left in the box so you can try again.
importFreeMonthlyUsage: Free plan: {used} of {limit} imports used this month
importFreeUpsell: Pro includes 20 imports a month, plus AI translation and photo tools.
importPdfNoText: This PDF has no readable text (it looks like a scan). Upload a photo of the menu instead.
importTranslatedNotice: This file is in {original}. AI translated it into your menu language, {base}. Please check the translations.
importTranslatedKeepOriginal: When you apply the draft, the {original} original is also saved as a second language if your language limit allows.
importTranslatedFreeHint: Your Free plan already uses both menu languages, so the {original} original isn’t saved. Upgrade to Pro to keep more languages.
importDiscardFailed: Couldn't discard the draft. Please try again.
importDiscardHint: Not happy with this result? Discard the draft and upload the file again.
importDraftNotStarted: The file was uploaded, but recognition hasn't started. Start it now, or discard and upload again.
importLegacyMismatchRetired: The last import was in a different language from your menu and was recognized before automatic translation was available, so it couldn't be applied. It has been discarded and doesn't count toward this month's quota. Upload the file again — new imports are translated into your menu language automatically.
